label: Add column password to User
summary: Adds column password to table User

precheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "information_schema"."columns" WHERE ("table_schema" = $1 AND "table_name" = $2 AND "column_name" = $3)) AS "result"

execute.sql: ALTER TABLE "public"."User" ADD COLUMN "password" text DEFAULT ('') NOT NULL
ALTER TABLE "public"."User" ALTER COLUMN "password" DROP DEFAULT

postcheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "information_schema"."columns" WHERE ("table_schema" = $1 AND "table_name" = $2 AND "column_name" = $3)) AS "result"
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "information_schema"."columns" WHERE ("table_schema" = $1 AND "table_name" = $2 AND "column_name" = $3 AND "is_nullable" = $4)) AS "result"

postcheck.description: verify column "password" has no default after temporary default removal
